about.title: Saran Nursing Home & Research Centre
about.lead: A local nursing home in Chapra, led by Dr. Neela Singh.
about.intro1: Saran Nursing Home & Research Centre is a nursing home in Sadhnapuri, Chapra, in the Saran district of Bihar.
about.intro2: Dr. Neela Singh is the owner and the doctor who sees patients here.
about.help1Body: Send a request online, or call or WhatsApp the clinic.
about.help2Body: Find the address, what to bring and how to reach us.
about.help3Body: Read this website in English, Hindi, Bhojpuri or Hinglish.

doctor.lead: Dr. Neela Singh is the owner of Saran Nursing Home and the doctor who sees patients here.

services.lead: Choose a service to learn more or book a visit.

womensHealth.title: Women's health consultation
womensHealth.short: See the doctor about women's health problems.
womensHealth.body: Meet the doctor to talk about periods, pain, infections or any other women's health concern. The doctor will check you and explain the next steps.

pregnancyCare.title: Pregnancy care
pregnancyCare.short: Regular check-ups and advice during pregnancy.
pregnancyCare.body: Regular check-ups through your pregnancy, with advice on tests, food and what to expect at each stage.

delivery.title: Delivery care
delivery.short: Care for mother and baby around childbirth.
delivery.body: Care for mothers at the time of delivery and in the days after. Talk to the doctor early in your pregnancy to plan ahead.

followUp.title: Follow-up visits
followUp.short: Come back to show reports or for a check-up.
followUp.body: Come back on the follow-up date given by the doctor, or when you have new test reports to show.

education.title: Health education
education.subtitle: Learn about your health from trusted sources

periods.title: Understanding your periods
periods.description: Menstruation is a natural process. Knowing what's normal helps you spot issues early.
periods.heavyBleeding: Very heavy bleeding (changing pad every 1-2 hours)
periods.irregularCycles: Cycles shorter than 21 or longer than 35 days
periods.tip1: Track your cycle with a calendar or app
periods.tip3: Stay hydrated and eat iron-rich foods
periods.tip5: See a doctor if something feels wrong

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy care guide
pregnancy.description: Each trimester brings changes. Regular check-ups keep you and your baby healthy.
pregnancy.firstTrimesterTips: Start prenatal vitamins, avoid alcohol/smoking, book first appointment
pregnancy.secondTrimesterTips: Anomaly scan, feel baby move, stay active, eat balanced meals
pregnancy.thirdTrimesterTips: Weekly visits near due date, pack hospital bag, prepare for birth
pregnancy.care4: Prepares you for labour and delivery
